extraction.Name: Darwin & Pena Peters, Deed (James Peters)
extraction.Recorded patent: Was it filed for record? no
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Not mortgaged but money borrowed from R. C. Spinning. The allottee sold three allotments to R. C. Spinning, for $6500 which was not the real value. Proceeds used to settle old debts to Spinning.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: no land sold for debt or taxes; proceeds used to settle old debts to Spinning
extraction.Fee Patent Date: Dec. 6, 1917; date and manner of delivery of patent March 16, 1918, Agency office
extraction.Occupation/Income: The only income of allottee is his share of the Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Decedent Darwin & Pena Peters; document executed by James Peters on December 3, 1928, notarized in Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929. Good health, no property or money accumulated. Wife and four minor children dependent upon allottee. Lands appear to have had a value of approximately $10,000.00; allottee appears to have been defrauded. Patent receipted: Yes. Questionnaire per Circular No. 2464, June 18, 1924. | Dual-allotment entry; Darwin & Pena Peters (deceased allottees) held allotments 362 and 363. James Peters is the heir/deponent.
